description: Keeping Vide UI fast in Roblox, and its sounds cached so they play on time. Load it with the roblox-dev:vide skill before building UI that opens and closes often, keeps pages or tabs, holds hundreds of instances or a long scrolling list, uses a CanvasGroup, or plays sounds; when a panel, tab switch, list, or world board stalls a frame or stays slow while it animates; when a closed panel still costs time; when a UI sound plays late; when UI flickers, draws blank at low graphics quality, or blinks white for a frame; and when asked to profile or optimize Vide UI.

results.query: My Vide shop menu stalls for a frame every time I switch tabs. What can I do about it?
Build a Vide leaderboard panel that lists every player's score in a scrolling list. Big servers can have a couple of thousand entries over a session.
The click sound on my Vide buttons plays late, especially the first time after joining. How do I make it play on time?
The script profiler says my Vide inventory panel costs about 3 ms a frame even while it's closed. Why, and how do I stop it?
On low graphics quality phones our Vide UI flickers and some panels draw blank. We use CanvasGroups for most fades.
Profile and optimize our Vide HUD. Frame times go up by several milliseconds whenever it's open.
A panel in my Vide UI flashes white for one frame as it appears. It fades in with a CanvasGroup.
Add a Vide settings menu with Audio, Video, and Controls tabs. Players open and close it a lot, so it should feel instant.
Our Vide quest panel grows in from scale 0 when it opens, and frames drop for the whole animation.
Each of the 300 cards in our Vide trading board shows a countdown and connects its own Heartbeat to update it. How do I make that cheaper?
Clients lag when around 500 unanchored parts are moving at once. How do I make the physics cheaper?
Our react-lua inventory list with 3,000 items stutters when scrolling. How do I virtualize it?
Footstep sounds on different floor materials play late on phones. The footstep script creates a Sound on the character's feet for every step.
My coins label in a Vide component shows the first value and never changes afterwards. Text = `Coins: {props.Coins()}`.
Write a UI Labs story for my Vide ShopItemCard component with controls for price and rarity.
Our remote events fire about 200 times a second per player and ping is high. How do I cut the network traffic?
My Vide hotbar covers the jump button on phones and looks tiny on my 1440p monitor. How do I make it fit every screen?
Client memory grows steadily during long sessions on mobile until the game crashes. How do I find what's leaking?
How do I use the MicroProfiler to tell whether a frame spike comes from layout, text, or rendering? Our UI is plain Instance.new code, no UI library.
Add a Charm signal for gems in the Currency module and show it next to coins in the Vide HUD.
